title: Connect your calendar and email (optional)
why: So your assistant can see when you are free and draft emails.
how: In the Claude app: Settings, Connectors, add Google Calendar and Gmail (or Microsoft 365). You sign in yourself.

title: Keep the computer awake while you want your assistant
why: Your assistant only works while this computer is on and awake.
how: Turn off sleep while plugged in (Windows: Settings, System, Power. Mac: System Settings, Battery or Energy).
